declaration.preface:
Mars Stitch Ltd. is dedicated to fostering a workplace that upholds the highest standards of labor and human rights. We believe that respect for the dignity, rights, and well-being of all individuals is fundamental to our operations. As a leader in the textile and garment industry, we recognize our responsibility to ensure ethical practices throughout our value chain. Our Labour and Human Rights Policy underscores our commitment to fair labor practices, non-discrimination, and a safe and supportive work environment.

At Mars Stitch Ltd., we understand that a fair and inclusive workplace not only drives employee satisfaction but also enhances organizational success. We are committed to embedding respect for human rights into all levels of our business operations, from hiring practices to day-to-day management. This holistic approach ensures that every employee and stakeholder experience dignity, fairness, and opportunity as part of the Mars Stitch Ltd. community.
declaration.declaration: Mars Stitch Ltd. is dedicated to fostering a fair and equitable workplace by adhering to the highest labor and human rights standards. By prioritizing ethical labor practices, ensuring diversity, and promoting a safe working environment, we aim to positively impact the lives of our employees and the communities in which we operate. Through rigorous adherence to international standards and local regulations, we are committed to making our operations a benchmark for labor and human rights excellence.
declaration.scope: This policy applies exclusively to the operations of Mars Stitch Ltd., covering all employees, workers, contractors, contractual worker, subcontractors, internal and external stakeholders directly associated with our facilities.

focusAreas: Freedom of Association and Collective Bargaining
Prohibition of Forced and Child Labor

Freedom of Association and Collective Ba: Ensure all employees are aware of their rights to organize and bargain collectively through regular informational sessions.
Conduct annual reviews of collective bargaining agreement to eliminate any barriers to freedom of association.
Facilitate annual meeting between employees and management to discuss and address collective concerns.
Support the establishment of workplace committees to enhance communication and representation.
Child Labor, Forced Labor, and Human Tra: Implement supplier audits to confirm zero tolerance for forced or child labor & Human Trafficking.
Establish training programs to educate stakeholders on recognizing and reporting unethical labor practices.
Collaborate with local organizations to create awareness campaigns against Child labor, forced labor & Human Trafficking.
Introduce whistleblower mechanisms to report any violations anonymously and securely.
Fair Wages and Working Hours: Regularly assess and adjust wages to ensure compliance with living wage standards.
Introduce digital timekeeping systems to accurately monitor and prevent excessive working hours.
Develop guidelines for overtime pay to ensure compliance with labor laws.
Publish transparent wage structures to eliminate any ambiguities in employee remuneration.
Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion: Conduct bias-awareness training for all managers and team leaders to foster an inclusive workplace culture.
Launch mentorship programs targeting underrepresented groups to enhance their career progression opportunities.
Ensure representation from diverse groups in recruitment panels.
Establish a grievance mechanism to address instances of discrimination promptly.
Safe and Healthy Workplace: Provide annual safety drills and health awareness programs for all employees.
Install safety equipment upgrades across all facilities.
Regularly inspect machinery and infrastructure to identify potential hazards.
Create health monitoring programs for workers in physically demanding roles.
Ethical Recruitment Practices: Partner with third-party organizations to ensure ethical recruitment for all subcontracted workers.
Maintain a transparent hiring process with multilingual documentation to prevent misunderstandings.
Establish pre-employment counselling to clarify terms and conditions for new hires.
External Stakeholder Human Rights: Develop a code of conduct for suppliers emphasizing human rights obligations.
Engage with local communities through workshops to promote labor rights awareness.
Establish grievance redressal mechanisms for external stakeholders affected by company operations.
Conduct annual assessments of suppliers' adherence to human rights standards.
Career Management and Training: Launch quarterly skills development programs to upskill employees for future roles.
Provide career planning services, including mentorship and tailored growth pathways.
Introduce leadership training modules to prepare employees for managerial roles.
Create an internal job board to promote career mobility within the company.
Employees’ Health and Safety: Install advanced safety monitoring systems across all facilities to identify and mitigate hazards proactively.
Conduct quarterly health and safety drills to prepare employees for emergencies.
Provide employees with comprehensive health benefits, including periodic medical check-ups and mental health support.

policy.monitoring:
Mars Stitch Ltd. is committed to continuous improvement in labor and human rights practices through:

Regular monitoring of key performance indicators (KPIs) related to worker welfare and safety.

Introducing technology solutions to enhance transparency in wage payments and working hours.

Strengthening grievance mechanisms to address and resolve worker concerns efficiently.

Collaborating with industry peers and non-governmental organizations to share best practices.

To ensure transparency and accountability:

Annual Review: Publish an annual Labor and Human Rights Report detailing compliance, progress, and future goals.

Stakeholder Communication: Share updates on key initiatives with employees, suppliers, and stakeholders through newsletters and meetings.

Incident Reporting: Maintain a transparent system for reporting and addressing workplace grievances.
policy.reviewMechanism: This policy will be reviewed annually by the Manager – HR, Admin & Com. to ensure its effectiveness and alignment with evolving regulations and industry standards. Stakeholder feedback will be integrated into updates, and revised policies will be communicated to all employees and partners.
